title: A pesar de las advertencias: conectores enfáticos
goal: Utilize emphatic concessive connectors ('a pesar de que', 'pese a que', 'si bien') to articulate rigorous formal and analytical arguments.
grammar: Conectores concesivos enfáticos: a pesar de que y si bien

sections.title: Unit 8: Concession & Counter-Argument — Lesson 2
body: Welcome to lesson 2 of Unit 8 (Concession & Counter-Argument). Mastering concessive nuances is fundamental for advanced debate, academic writing, and diplomatic discourse in Spanish.
In this lesson, we examine a pesar de las advertencias: conectores enfáticos, calibrating indicative vs. subjunctive triggers to construct persuasive counter-arguments.

items: Utilize emphatic concessive connectors ('a pesar de que', 'pese a que', 'si bien') to articulate rigorous formal and analytical arguments.
Incorporate upper-intermediate debate lexicon (el contratiempo, adverso).
